rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 9 research centers (10 datasets) from the DIDA-MDD Working Group in China: CMU, CSU, GCMU1, GCMU2, KMU, PKU, SCU, SWU, YMU, ZZU. GCMU1 and GCMU2 were collected using the same scanner at one site with different scan parameters. All data obtained using 3T MRI scanners.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "we used a strictly quality-controlled imaging dataset, including 1148 patients with MDD and 1079 matched HCs from 9 research centers from the DIDA-MDD"; "The GCMU1 and GCMU2 datasets were collected using the same scanner at one site with different scan parameters."
